#| label: fig-outcomesforest
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| fig-cap: "Association between outcomes and ANOCA/Comparator"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

outcomesforestfunc_inner <- function(time, event, eventname, xvar = "case",
                                     stratavar = NULL) {
  crudemod <- summary(coxph(formula(paste0("Surv(", time, ",", event, "== 'Yes') ~ ", xvar, " + frailty(lopnrcase)")),
    data = sdata
  ))

  coxvars <- modvars
  coxvars[coxvars %in% stratavar] <- paste0("strata(", coxvars[coxvars %in% stratavar], ")")

  adjmod <- summary(coxph(
    formula(paste0(
      "Surv(", time, ",", event, "== 'Yes') ~ ", xvar, "+",
      paste(coxvars, collapse = " + "), "+ frailty(lopnrcase)"
    )),
    data = sdata
  ))

  out <- tibble(
    Outcome = eventname,
    hr_c = crudemod$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"],
    hr_a = adjmod$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"],
    lci_c = crudemod$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
    lci_a = adjmod$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
    uci_c = crudemod$conf.int[1, "upper .95"],
    uci_a = adjmod$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  )
  return(out)
}

out1 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[1],
  event = outvars$var[1],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[1]
)
out2 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[2],
  event = outvars$var[2],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[2]
)
out3 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[3],
  event = outvars$var[3],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[3]
)
out4 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[4],
  event = outvars$var[4],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[4]
)
nr <- 5
out5 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[nr],
  event = outvars$var[nr],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[nr]
)
nr <- 6
out6 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[nr],
  event = outvars$var[nr],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[nr]
)
nr <- 7
out7 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[nr],
  event = outvars$var[nr],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[nr],
  stratavar = "sos_com_cancer3y"
)
nr <- 8
out8 <- outcomesforestfunc_inner(
  time = outvars$time[nr],
  event = outvars$var[nr],
  eventname = outvars$shortname[nr]
)
plotdata <- rbind(out1, out2, out3, out4, out5, out6, out7, out8) %>%
  mutate(
    `Crude\nHR (95% CI)` = paste0(
      fn(hr_c, dig = 2),
      " (", fn(lci_c, dig = 2),
      "-", fn(uci_c, dig = 2), ")"
    ),
    `Adjusted\nHR (95% CI)` = paste0(
      fn(hr_a, dig = 2),
      " (", fn(lci_a, dig = 2),
      "-", fn(uci_a, dig = 2), ")"
    )
  )

plotdata$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", nrow(plotdata)), collapse = " ")

tm <- forest_theme(
  core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("#F0F0F0", "white"))),
  base_size = 14,
  refline_gp = gpar(lty = "solid"),
  ci_col = global_cols[1:2],
  ci_lwd = 2.5,
  legend_name = NULL,
  legend_position = "bottom",
  arrow_length = 0.08,
  # xaxis_ticks_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
  #  arrow_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
  legend_value = c("Crude", "Adjusted")
  # legend_gp = gpar(cex = 0.65, fontsize = 14)
) # ,
# Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
# core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

# Draw the forest plot with rearranged columns
p <- forest(plotdata[, c(1, 10, 8, 9)],
  est = list(plotdata$hr_c, plotdata$hr_a),
  lower = list(plotdata$lci_c, plotdata$lci_a),
  upper = list(plotdata$uci_c, plotdata$uci_a),
  ci_column = 2,
  sizes = 0.6,
  nudge_y = 0.35,
  x_trans = "log",
  arrow_lab = c("Better", "Worse"),
  xlim = c(0.3, 6),
  ticks_at = c(0.3, 1, 6),
  theme = tm
)
